observedProblem: Source review found a missing validation of duplicate JSON object keys. JsonElement.TryGetProperty selects an implementation-defined occurrence for duplicate security fields; requestId, kind and routeId may become ambiguous across JS and C# parsers. A malformed UI message could be interpreted differently than the intended native action. This is a source-level potential defect, not an observed Windows exploit.
actualFix: Enumerate parsed JSON properties before native admission; count exact case-sensitive requestId/kind/routeId keys within already bounded JSON input. Duplicate requestId is dropped without an ambiguous ACK; duplicates of kind or routeId receive REJECTED/P01_BAD_MESSAGE only if a unique fresh requestId can safely correlate the response. Do not reserve IDs or call consent/native routes for malformed messages. Preserve R09 duplicate replay check before general schema validation.
